verses.text: "Even today my complaint sounds rebellious. His hand weighs heavily on me despite my groaning.
If only I knew where to find him! Then I could go straight to his seat.
I'd lay out my case before him and have my arguments ready.
I'd find out what he'd say in reply and understand what he told me.
Would he argue against me with all his power? No, he'd listen to me.
There an upright person could reason with him, and I'd be acquitted by my judge for good.
If I go east, he's nowhere to be found. If I go west, I can't find him.
When he's at work in the north, I can't see him. He turns south, and I can't catch a glimpse of him.
But he knows the path I'm taking. When he's tested me, I'll come out like gold.
My feet have followed his steps closely. I've stayed on his path without turning away.
I haven't turned back from what he commanded. I've treasured his words more than the food I need.
He stands alone. Who can stand against him? He does whatever he desires.
He carries out what he's appointed for me, and he has many more things like that in store.
That's why I'm terrified in his presence. The more I think about it, the more I fear him.
God has made me lose heart. The Almighty has terrified me.
I wasn't cut off before the darkness came, and he hasn't hidden the thick darkness from my face."
